svg.aria-label: The blast radius of the two irreversible utilities. reset deletes every data access role on the item, including roles config never declared and DefaultReader, so nobody reads the data through OneLake security afterwards; it writes a role backup first and aborts without deleting if that write fails, and it leaves the control tables alone. cleanup drops all four control tables, including the entire audit history, and deletes every file under the security folder, including every pre-apply role backup; it leaves the live roles alone. The two interlock: cleanup destroys the backups reset depends on, so running cleanup first makes reset unrecoverable. Neither is a deployment mode, both are refused from the pipeline entrypoints and are available only interactively, by name.

config, mapping, member, the audit history

cleanup() deletes the backups reset() depends on
